He won the Masters in 2022 and 2024 and has not finished outside the top 20 at Augusta National. Earlier this year, he won in La Quinta and finished inside the top four in Phoenix and Pebble Beach. He had top-10 performances in 17 of his 20 starts on the PGA Tour in 2025 and his six victories included the PGA Championship at Quail Hollow Club and The Open at Royal Portrush. The 2024 Olympic Gold Medalist in Paris has earned each of his PGA Tour wins since February 2022.
